cases.name: Dashboard counts reconcile to every saved graph record, including an explicit held-record fixture
Batch bars preserve all recorded fields with no inferred scientific values
Empty workspace displays zero counts and no fabricated analytics
Context and controlled lifecycle records remain included in the six groups
Large groups paginate every record exactly once without dropping the final partial page
Selecting an off-page record brings its true page into the visible graph
Over-large page requests remain within the final existing page
Canvas edges are only actual saved edges with two visible endpoints
UI projections leave source bytes, numeric lexemes and approval state unchanged
Unassigned batches remain explicit and do not disappear from the chart denominator
New cockpit has six zero-count stages and a source-first step for an empty workspace
Stale dependencies take priority over downstream review suggestions
Open conflicts remain a visible next step
A saved source is not presented as approved extracted facts
Stale cached QC cannot enter the non-stale QC count
Next-step guidance never mutates evidence or approval state

boundary: Saved-data UI projection engineering checks only. No rendered browser, pixel-fidelity, WebGL, hosted sign-in, scientific accuracy or production validation claim.
